title: Nextdoor Post Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nextdoor:post
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(category) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Nextdoor post events land each day and how many distinct category values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Nextdoor post records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct category values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Nextdoor post activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
